status: prospective specification for a separate post-hoc exploratory mechanism follow-up
question: Does freeing the boundary transformations help more than freeing two interior transformations, when capacity, branch-use counts, initial function, data stream, optimizer and computation are held fixed?

provenance.explanation: New END/INNER arms use cloned C-initialized branches. Historical H8 used separate branch initialization draws. Do not relabel new END results as the historical H8 result.

model.initialization: Same-seed native C stem/head/first branch stream; copy the initial first branch state into all three independent branch parameter objects. Both arms and native C must have identical initial logits before any update. Parameter objects must remain independent.
model.normalization: Native affine GroupNorm, no BatchNorm running statistics
model.factory_scope: Dedicated single-process run-local engine.build_model substitution; restore in finally; checkpoint reconstruction requires the explicit arm map and companion treatment identity

primary_analysis.interval: two-sided Student t 95%, df=4, nominal and unadjusted
primary_analysis.selection_caveat: Validation is reused for model selection and evaluation, already known and not an independent holdout. Effect is conditional on this recipe and selection rule, not a new unbiased test estimate.
primary_analysis.interpretation: Positive observed effect favors boundary placement, negative favors interior placement. An interval crossing zero does not establish equivalence or lack of a mechanism. No outcome-dependent extensions or tuning.

secondary_analyses: Selected-checkpoint validation cross-entropy and native 15-bin ECE
Fixed 10000-update train/validation accuracy, validation cross-entropy and generalization gap
Same-update learning trajectories; selected and fixed-budget checkpoints must never be conflated
Frozen C8 validation results as explicitly historical reference, not a retrained control
Paired per-example correctness/NLL/confidence decomposition for END-INNER and historical H8-C8 on the identical validation examples
Per-class validation error-count differences, descriptive only; 50 validation examples/class, no classwise significance claims

Per-use gradient decomposition on one fixed clean training batch of128 per seed, at common initialization and selected checkpoints; verify untied-copy gradient sums reproduce native tied gradients. Local conflicts are diagnostics, not proof of global learning causation.

diagnostics.partition: Only the original training subset and fixed validation split, never official test
diagnostics.fixed_training_batch: numpy.default_rng(100000+paired_seed), choose128 training-subset indices without replacement, no augmentation, cross-entropy mean reduction
diagnostics.gradient_reference: Native B8 occurrence clones with all stem/head/branch states copied from the evaluated model. Same logits and same per-group summed parameter gradients are mandatory conservation checks.
diagnostics.reference_checkpoint_verification: Copied frozen H8/C8 selected checkpoints must match public freeze SHA256; validation predictions must reproduce frozen top1 within1e-12 and CE/ECE within2e-5. All copies remain private.

output_contract.public_artifacts: Protocol, source, sanitized native run configs/compressed scalar logs, freeze/preregistration/validation receipts, aggregate diagnostics, analysis tables/figures/report. No weights, images, private raw prediction arrays, host/account paths or operational credentials.
